import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Set up the style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = (16, 12)

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Price vs Megapixels scatter plot
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(data['megapixels'], data['price_usd'], 
                     c=data['model_year'], s=data['weight_grams']/5, 
                     alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis', edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels\n(size=weight, color=year)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar1 = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar1.set_label('Year', fontsize=9)

# 2. Brand distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
brand_counts = data['brand'].value_counts()
colors_brand = sns.color_palette("husl", len(brand_counts))
ax2.bar(brand_counts.index, brand_counts.values, color=colors_brand, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Camera Count by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 3. Sensor Type distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
sensor_counts = data['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors_sensor = sns.color_palette("Set2", len(sensor_counts))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors_sensor, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Price by Brand
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
brands = data['brand'].unique()
colors_box = sns.color_palette("Set1", len(brands))
bp = ax4.boxplot([data[data['brand'] == brand]['price_usd'].values for brand in brands],
                  labels=brands, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors_box):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
ax4.set_xlabel('Brand', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Price Distribution by Brand', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 5. Weight vs Max ISO
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
scatter2 = ax5.scatter(data['weight_grams'], data['max_iso'], 
                      c=data['price_usd'], s=100, alpha=0.7, 
                      cmap='coolwarm', edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax5.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Weight vs Max ISO (color=price)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar2 = plt.colorbar(scatter2, ax=ax5)
cbar2.set_label('Price (USD)', fontsize=9)

# 6. Body Type distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
body_counts = data['body_type'].value_counts()
colors_body = sns.color_palette("pastel", len(body_counts))
ax6.barh(body_counts.index, body_counts.values, color=colors_body, edgecolor='black')
ax6.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Body Type', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 7. 4K Video capability
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
video_4k = data['has_video_4k'].value_counts()
labels_4k = ['No 4K', '4K']
colors_4k = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
ax7.bar(labels_4k, [video_4k.get(0, 0), video_4k.get(1, 0)], 
        color=colors_4k, edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('4K Video Capability', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Model Year distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
year_counts = data['model_year'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax8.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='#2ecc71', markeredgecolor='black')
ax8.fill_between(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, alpha=0.3, color='#2ecc71')
ax8.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Cameras by Model Year', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 9. Lens Mount distribution
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
mount_counts = data['lens_mount'].value_counts()
colors_mount = sns.color_palette("muted", len(mount_counts))
ax9.bar(mount_counts.index, mount_counts.values, color=colors_mount, edgecolor='black')
ax9.set_xlabel('Lens Mount', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Lens Mount Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Add main title
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Adjust layout and save
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
